prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) round leafy bush; 2) bush with small berries; 3) fern clump; 4) cluster of thick gnarled tree roots breaking out of the ground (wide, low); 5) second root cluster, mossy; 6) large mossy boulder; 7) grey boulder with cracks; 8) fallen mossy log; 9) small grass tuft; 10) second grass tuft, taller; 11) tiny clump of wildflowers; 12) few small pebbles; 13) scatter of fallen leaves; 14) two small brown mushrooms; 15) small reed clump.
Scale: bushes about 28 art pixels wide, the root clusters about 46 wide and 20 tall, grass tufts about 12 wide, pebbles about 12 wide; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create ONE transparent-background sprite sheet of exactly 15 distinct environment props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG. Canvas arranged as THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, strict reading order left to right and top to bottom. Each object isolated and centered within its own generously spaced cell, wide transparent gutters, no touching, no clipping. Objects depicted in classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle: top and front visible, upright objects' bases at bottom. Row 1: (1) round leafy green bush, (2) leafy bush with tiny berries, (3) fern clump. Row 2: (4) thick gnarled tree roots emerging from ground, wide and low, (5) a different cluster of thick gnarled roots with moss, (6) large mossy boulder. Row 3: (7) gray cracked boulder, (8) fallen mossy log, (9) short small grass tuft. Row 4: (10) second taller grass tuft, (11) tiny clump of wildflowers, (12) a few small pebbles. Row 5: (13) scatter of fallen leaves, (14) two small brown mushrooms, (15) small reed clump. Bushes ~28 art pixels wide; root clusters ~46 art pixels wide and 20 tall; grass and pebbles ~12 art pixels wide. Consistent enlarged art pixels as hard-edged identical square pixels (~6-8 output pixels to each art pixel); genuine meticulously hand-placed premium HD pixel art, pixel clusters of 3-10 squares, coherent discrete color blocks and silhouettes. Earthy rich worn-in colors, 4-6 shades per material, hue shifted ramps: purple-reddish saturated shadows, warm-yellow highlights. Neutral even soft upper-left overcast daylight, base colors only. Absolutely transparent alpha background; absolutely NO ground, floor, platforms, cast shadows, drop shadows, letters, labels, numbers, borders, grids, connecting elements, glow, vignette, anti-aliasing, blurred or soft-brush edges, smooth vector shapes, photographic textures, random noise, checkerboard dithering. Preserve space for broad roots without reducing visible pixel size of other sprites.
